HKPROBE available=true args=["noauth", "readonly"]
HKPROBE status steps=2 hr=2
HKPROBE read HKCategoryTypeIdentifierSleepAnalysis n=1 err=nil
HKPROBE read HKQuantityTypeIdentifierStepCount n=1 err=nil
HKPROBE   value=4242 count
HKPROBE read HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate n=1 err=nil
HKPROBE   value=72 count/min
HKPROBE done
